name: print-social-email-campaign-strips-in-royal-blue-with-seasonal-themes
title: Royal-blue email newsletters for a vitamin brand across back-to-school, Halloween and sale themes
whatItIs: Twelve tall email layouts side by side, mostly cobalt and periwinkle. They combine product tub photography, cloud or bat decorations, round discount badges, orange CTA buttons, review cards with photos, step lists and a green football-field variant.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and promotional; a fixed blue base with seasonal props keeps every send recognisable.
techniques: Keep a constant blue base and swap seasonal decorations.
Use bright orange buttons for every call to action.
Present offers as round starburst badges.
Combine customer review cards with product hero shots.

vocabulary.definition: Temporary decorative theme on a fixed system.
A round or starburst label showing a percentage off.
A card with a customer photo, stars and quote.
